shots.line: Seven weeks earlier, Friday night, September 12th, 2014.
shots.what: 3D: the barracks at night, then a fast fly-in onto the sign: CHAPTER 01 / THE BARRACKS types on; date stamp types on

shots.line: The Pennsylvania State Police barracks in Blooming Grove
shots.what: real photo: the barracks with police tape, days after (WNEP)

shots.line: in Pike County
shots.what: road map: amber pin on the barracks, label types on

shots.line: has forest pressing in on almost every side.
shots.what: 3D: from above, the building and lot ringed by dark woods, pushing down

shots.line: It's shortly before eleven, and it's shift change.
shots.what: 3D: the lot under its lamps, the lit lobby door; SHORTLY BEFORE 11 PM types on

shots.line: One group of troopers
shots.what: 3D: two troopers in campaign hats walking out of the lobby door

shots.line: is finishing up and another is arriving.
shots.what: 3D: a cruiser pulling into the lot from the drive

shots.line: Corporal Bryon Dickson is one of the troopers on his way out. He's thirty-eight, from Dunmore, a Marine veteran, married with two young sons.
shots.what: his official portrait, name types on, then three facts one at a time as they are said; slow, no effects

shots.line: Early accounts say he was heading toward his patrol car.
shots.what: 3D: behind a trooper walking from the door toward a cruiser in its bay

shots.line: Dickson had his own assigned cruiser at Blooming Grove.
shots.what: 3D: slow push on the cruiser in its bay, an amber edge of light on it (the planted detail)

shots.line: Hold on to that. It comes back at the end of this story.
shots.what: 3D: closer, low, along the cruiser's side

shots.line: A rifle shot comes out of the dark,
shots.what: 3D: the tree line across the road, locked camera; one flash of light in the trees. Nobody is shown.

shots.line: and Dickson goes down outside the building.
shots.what: 3D: the front of the building and the empty walk, slow push. No figure.

shots.line: Trooper Alex Douglass, thirty-one,
shots.what: his official portrait, name types on

shots.line: has just arrived for his shift along with three other troopers.
shots.what: 3D: four troopers by their cars in the lot

shots.line: He carries a gym bag out to his own vehicle,
shots.what: 3D object: the gym bag in his hand as he walks, low tracking shot

shots.line: hears a noise, and sees Dickson on the ground.
shots.what: 3D: close on a trooper, head turned toward the building. What he sees is not shown.

shots.line: He goes toward him, and he's shot too.
shots.what: 3D: the tree line again from another spot, locked camera; a second flash. Nobody is shown.

shots.line: Badly wounded, Douglass gets himself into the lobby.
shots.what: 3D: the lobby door, warm light on the walk, push in. No figure.

shots.line: Two troopers pull him farther inside.
shots.what: 3D: two troopers kneeling in the doorway, backs to the camera

shots.line: Officers and paramedics worked on Bryon Dickson, and they couldn't save him.
shots.what: real photo: the barracks behind police tape in daylight; the slowest shot of the chapter

shots.line: Alex Douglass survived.
shots.what: Douglass's portrait again, push

shots.line: He was in the hospital until the middle of October, then moved to a rehabilitation facility.
shots.what: same portrait; two facts type on as they are said

shots.line: By late March 2015, he said he had already been through sixteen surgeries, with another one scheduled.
shots.what: same portrait; 16 SURGERIES types on big at the word

shots.line: Weeks later, police would have a few torn notebook pages describing that night.
shots.what: 3D object: three torn notebook pages under a lamp, push in (the writing is not legible on purpose)

shots.line: One line is in the court record. "Got a shot around eleven PM and took it."
shots.what: the Philadelphia Inquirer headline quoting the journal; amber highlighter sweeps across the quote as it is read

shots.line: That night, though, nobody knew who had written anything.
shots.what: 3D: the barracks from across the road, through the edge of the trees

shots.line: Whoever fired those shots had disappeared into the trees.
shots.what: 3D: the amber figure walking away into the woods across the road

shots.line: There was no suspect and no name. They didn't even have a vehicle.
shots.what: typed card: SUSPECT, NAME, VEHICLE, each struck through in amber as it is said

shots.line: That changed within days.
shots.what: real photo: the Jeep in the water (tease for the next chapter)
